newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bomb blasts Colombian Red Cross offices.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blasts Colombian Red Cross offices.

text.p: A small bomb exploded outside Red Cross offices in the northwest Colombian city of Medellin, injuring two passers-by and causing damage, police said Thursday.
The attack, which took place Wednesday evening, was thought to be the first in Colombia against the Red Cross, a spokesman for the organisation said.
Police said the device consisted of one-and-a-half pounds of dynamite and blew out windows and damaged part of the rear of the building.
The two injured people were thought to be beggars, a police spokesman said. He said no group had claimed responsibility for the blast.
